$comment: TEST FIXTURE — deliberately invalid. Adds a 'requiredWhen' guard to an inherited group member that has none, so a capability status would be required only where the status is 'planned' — a condition that reads its own answer. This is the relaxation hardest to see by reading: the rule is still listed, still appears in every report, and quietly stops firing for most entries. Not a real profile; do not copy.
title: Adding a guard to an inherited rule (test fixture)
